Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game but we have another game coming up on this Super Saturday! It is New Zealand facing Sri Lanka. Do join us that game at 1900 Local (1100 GMT). Until then, cheers.

Stafanie Taylor, the West Indies skipper, says that she is really happy with her performance and her team's performance. Says that she is really happy with the team and tells that its nice to have everyone back in the side. On the bowling, Taylor says that Connell has been working really hard with Courtney Walsh and that was evident in her bowling. Feels that they played quite a few dot balls and they would look to sort it out and rotate strike. Ends by saying that they could've had done better against the Thai side.

Sornnarin Tippoch, the Thailand skipper, says that she is happy with her performance. Tells that they needed to get around 120. Adds that they need to keep improving in all the areas. States that they need to work on their off side game. Finishes by saying that their bowling is their strength. Feels that their bowling and fielding was excellent in this game. Finishes by saying that they were waiting for the day and is proud of her team.

STAFANIE TAYLOR IS THE MAN OF THE MATCH. She starts by saying that the bowlers bowled really well and it was her batting which was an issue. She felt that she needed to stick it out in the middle. Adds that they needed to take their time out and credits the bowling. On her not bowling full quota of bowling, Taylor says that she keeps telling her coaches that give her less bowlers in the side so she does not feel like giving the ball to everyone.

Earlier in the game, after being asked to bowl first, West Indies scuffed Thailand and did not give them easy runs at all. The Thai team could only manage 78 runs, that too after the effort from Koncharoenkai who scored 33 of the total. Skipper Taylor led from the front with a 3-fer. Other bowlers chipped in with wickets at regular intervals and kept things tight. Stay with us for the presentation.

Defending a small total, the Thai bowlers did exceptional work, provided this was their first-ever outing in a World Cup game. Boochatham, Sutthiruang and Laomi were very economical in their spells but failed to pick wickets. Lateh was the one who got the wicket apart from two run outs that came with fielding brilliance from Laomi and Chaiwai. Eventually, the total was a little too less to defend and Thailand ended up on a losing side.

The run chase didn't start well for West Indies as they failed to rotate strike early on. Thailand bowled tight lines and didn't allow them to score freely. A couple of runs outs thumped the run chase but skipper Taylor and Campbelle made sure they open their account on the points table.

An easy victory in the end for West Indies. They would've had some nerves when Thailand picked a couple of wickets quickly but the experienced duo of Stafanie Taylor and Shemaine Campbelle took the Windies home with an unbeaten 50-run stand.

FOUR! That's the end of the game! West Indies took some time to finish this game but have achieved it eventually! Flighted ball on middle, Campbelle sweeps it to the deep square leg region for a boundary. WEST INDIES WOMEN WIN BY 7 WICKETS.
Full on middle, Campbelle pushes it back to the bowler.
Looped up ball on the pads, Taylor flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Floated on the pads, Taylor looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it. It goes on to hit the pads.
Flatter one on off, Campbelle punches it towards mid off. 12 came off the over. 4 more required.
FOUR! Nice touch! Flatter one outside off, Campbelle late cuts it through the third man region for a boundary.
FOUR! There is no one in the deep! Short delivery on the pads, Campbelle pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Flatter one on off, pushed to point.
Very full delivery outside off, Taylor drives it through the cover region and picks up three before the fielder can clean it up.
Tossed up ball on middle, Campbelle pushes it down to long on for a single.
Soraya Lateh returns. 2-0-9-1 from her so far.
Loopy delivery on off, Taylor defends this one out. 16 required off the last five overs.
Taylor defends this floated ball on middle back to the bowler.
Flighted one on middle, Campbelle flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Tosses this one on off, Campbelle defends this to the off side.
Floated ball outside off, Campbelle looks to defend but misses it altogether.
Flighted ball around off, Campbelle looks to defend but it goes in between the bat and pad, into the keeper's gloves.
Nattaya Boochatham is back on.
Flatter one outside off, Taylor cuts it but finds the point fielder. That ends a top spell from Laomi. 4-1-14-0 from her.
Short delivery outside off, Campbelle punches it to the deep cover region for a single.
Short ball down the leg side, Campbelle pulls it to the fine leg region for a couple.
Flatter one on off, Campbelle punches it to point.
FOUR! Swept away nicely! Flighted on middle, Campbelle goes on her knees and then sweeps it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Short delivery outside off, Campbelle looks to cut but misses it altogether.
BEATEN! Tosses this one up outside off, Taylor looks to drive but fails to get any bat on it.
Another short one on off, Campbelle pushes it to the long off for another run.
Shorter one on off, Taylor punches it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tossed up ball on middle, Taylor bends and plays it to the fine leg region for a boundary. Takes a little pressure off Taylor. 50 up for the Windies.
Loopy one on off, Taylor defends it out.
Shorter one outside off, Campbelle punches it to the off side for a single.
Onnicha Kamchomphu is into the attack.
Short delivery on off, cut to point. Maiden over from Laomi. 31 required from the last 8 overs.
Loopy delivery outside off, Taylor drives it to cover for another dot ball.
Tossed up ball on middle, Taylor defends it back to the bowler.
Short ball on middle, Taylor pulls it to mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Taylor pushes it to the cover region.
Flatter one outside off, left alone by Taylor.
BEATEN! Loopy one outside off, Campbelle looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
Shorter one on off, Campbelle punches it to the deep cover region for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Flatter one on off, pushed to deep cover for a couple.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short ball outside off, Taylor cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Short ball on off, Taylor pulls it to mid on.
Sornnarin Tippoch is into the attack.
MISFIELD! Short one outside off, Taylor punches it to point where the fielder misfields allowing the batters to take a single. 41/3 at the halfway mark.
Loopy delivery on off, Taylor drives it straight to cover.
Another flat one outside off, Campbelle punches it to the off side for a single.
WIDE! Full delivery down the leg side, Campbelle looks to sweep but misses. Wide given.
Shorter one outside off, Taylor punches it to deep cover for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Taylor defends it back to the bowler.
Flatter one outside off, Taylor looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
On a length on middle, Taylor flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
LEG BYE! Fullish delivery on the pads, Campbelle looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to square leg and the batters steal a leg bye.
Slower one on the pads, Taylor flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Stafanie pushes it down to mid on.
Full on off, Taylor prods forward and defends it out.
FOUR! Lovely control from the skipper! Good length ball outside off, Taylor cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Dot to end! Another short ball, Campbelle once again fails to find the gap and ends up punching it to the extra cover fielder.
Shortish and outside off again, Taylor drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Misfield and a run! Short and outside off again, cut towards point where the fielder this time fumbles and they get a run.
Short and wide outside off, Campbelle cuts but finds the point fielder.
Full and around off, Campbelle pushes it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched towards covers for a single.
Suleeporn Laomi is into the attack.

NOT OUT! Campbelle can breathe a sigh of relief. What a delivery from Sutthiruang though. She nails the yorker on the pads. Campbelle tries flicking but misses. Thailand roar an appeal and the umpire agrees with them. Both the batters get together and discuss the DRS and at the very last second they take it upstairs. The replay roll in and show that there is no involvement of the bat. Is it hitting the stumps? It is not which is confirmed by the Ball Tracker, missing the leg pole by a big margin. Excellent use of the review from West Indies.

Has Thailand got another one? Campbelle has been given out LBW but she takes the decision upstairs at the very last second. Looks really close. There is no bat involved. Is it hitting the stumps? No, missing by some margin.
Around off, Campbelle defends it out.
Shemaine Campbelle replaces Deandra Dottin out in the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! This is a massive wicket for Thailand. Excellent work from Laomi. Thailand are making this run chase exciting here. Sutthiruang bowls a length ball around off, Taylor taps it towards point and goes for the quick run. Laomi at point quickly gets to the ball and fires a superb throw just over the stumps for the keeper who quickly whips the bails off. The third umpire has been called for the and the replays show that Dottin is short.
A run out appeal has been taken upstairs. Dottin is the batter in question. It looks close. Let's see what happens.
Appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Another length ball from Sutthiruang. This one pitches and comes into the batter. Taylor looks to defend but she misses to get hit on the pads.
Fuller and around off, Taylor comes forward and defends it out.
Gets the line right and bowls this length ball just outside off, Dottin strokes it through covers for a run.
WIDE! Sutthiruang starts her spell by dishing this full ball down the leg side. Dottin looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Chanida Sutthiruang is into the attack.
Shortish and around off, pushed back to the bowler. 25/2 at the end of the Powerplay. Thailand were 27/2 at the same point.
On the pads, worked behind square leg for a run by Dottin to get off the mark.
Full and around off, Dottin drives it well but the cover fielder makes an excellent diving stop to her right.
Deandra Dottin is the next batter in.

OUT! Timber! Lateh says she will do it all by herself. Joy for Thailand. Brilliant bowling from Lateh. Bowls this quicker one on middle, Matthews tries to pull but misses and the ball goes behind to disturb the middle pole.

Dropped! Another tough chance though! Quicker and outside off, Matthews looks to drive but the ball takes a thick  edge and goes behind. The ball does not stick in the gloves of the keeper there and comes out.
Floated around off, Matthews keeps it out.
Soraya Lateh too has a change of ends. 1-0-8-0 are her figures so far.
Shortish and around off, punched towards covers by Matthews for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! This time Matthews finds the elevation and creams this full ball outside off over Tippoch. She leaps high to catch but it goes well over her for a boundary.
Flatter and around off, pushed towards mid-wicket.

Dropped! But it was a difficult chance for the Thai skipper! Full and outside off, Matthews drives it towards covers where Tippoch dives to her left but fails to hold on. She got both the hands but it popped out.
Shortish and outside off, Matthews looks to cut but misses.
Stafanie Taylor, the skipper is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bull's eye from Chaiwai. Floated delivery around off, Kirby pushes it towards point and calls for a quick run. There is a slight hesitation as they start and stop but they eventually go for the run. Chaiwai from point picks the ball and throws the ball at the non-striker's end. It hits the stumps and Kirby is short. The umpire raises his finger.
Around off, Matthews watchfully defends it out. 2 from the over, a good one from Boochatham.
Another full ball on the pads, Kirby once again misses her flick. This time the ball hits her pad and goes towards short fine leg. They steal a leg bye.

Huge appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Looked to be going down the leg side. Boochatham bowls another quicker one on the pads, Kirby once again fails to flick and is hit on the pads. They appeal but nothing doing.
WIDE! Down the leg side now, Kirby tries flicking but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Three dots in a row! Boochatham bowls this one slower through the air and on middle, Kirby keeps it out.
Short and outside off, Kirby cuts but can't find the gap, finds the point fielder.
Flatter one on the pads, worked towards short fine leg.
Nattaya Boochatham has change of ends. 1-0-2-0 are her figures so far.
A couple to end the over! Short and around off, Matthews goes on the back foot and punches it through cover-point. Before the fielder can get to the ball, a couple is taken.
Flatter and outside off, Matthews looks to drive but the ball hits the upper part of her bat and rolls towards cover.
Quicker one around middle, it is pushed to mid off.

FOUR! Just over the short third man fielder! Short and outside off from Padunglerd, Matthews looks to cut but the ball takes the thick outside edge and flies over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Shortish one on middle, Kirby works it towards square leg and takes a quick run.
Padunglerd starts with a quicker one on middle, Kirby pushes it back to the bowler.
Ratanaporn Padunglerd is into the attack now.
FOUR! Driven nicely! First boundary of the run chase. A fuller ball outside off, Matthews opens up the off side and drills it through covers to bag a boundary.
Flatter and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Loopy and around middle, worked towards fine leg for a run.

WIDE! This is a poor ball. That probably slipped out of her hand. It pitched way down the leg side. Kirby tries to sweep but it is beyond her reach. The short fine leg fielder chases and keeps it two. Wided by the umpire.
Short and outside off, Kirby cuts it well but can't beat the point fielder who dives to her left to make a good stop.
On off, it is defended.
Floated around off, turning into the batter, Kirby pushes it towards covers.
Soraya Lateh will bowl from the other end.
Full and outside off, Matthews drives it well but it goes straight to the cover fielder.
On the pads, Kirby tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.

That is a brilliant delivery from Boochatham. She flights this and bowls it fuller one and outside off, Kirby looks to drive but the ball drifts away from her and goes to the keeper who fails to hold on. There is some excitement from the Thai team as there was some noise as the ball passed the bat. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that the noise was of the bat hitting the ground.
The run chase is underway! A flatter ball around off, Matthews forces it towards mid on where the fielder misfields and a run is taken.
Boochatham starts with a loopy ball on middle, Matthews works it towards mid-wicket.

We are back for the chase! West Indies just need 79 to win. The Thailand players make their way out to the middle followed the Windies openers, Hayley Matthews and Lee-Ann Kirby. Nattaya Boochatham to bowl for Thailand first up.
